title: Recipe 67 — Human-in-the-loop approvals that survive a restart

beats.cue: “runs resume is the other half: the session was PARKED, not killed, so granting the approval lets it carry on.”

beats.label: Read it

beats.label: Grant it

beats.label: Resume the session
beats.cue: [needs-key] “The parked session picks up exactly where it stopped. Nothing was re-run, and nothing was lost.”
